lines.t: Costco has sold this hot dog and soda for a dollar fifty since the nineteen-eighties. And they refuse to change it.
lines.title: STILL *$1.50*

lines.t: With inflation, that combo should cost around four dollars and forty cents today.
lines.label: Inflation-adjusted price
lines.title: IT SHOULD *COST*

lines.t: Years ago, the CEO told co-founder Jim Sinegal they were losing money on it. His answer? If you raise the hot dog, I will kill you. Figure it out.
lines.title: THE *ORDER*

items.label: We're losing money on the hot dog
If you raise the hot dog, I will kill you. Figure it out.

lines.source: Craig Jelinek, as reported by Fox Business

lines.t: So they figured it out. Costco built its own hot dog factories to cut the cost.
lines.title: HOW THEY *DID IT*

lines.t: Here's the trick. It's a loss leader. The hot dog brings you in… and you leave with a three-hundred-dollar cart.
lines.title: THE *REAL* GAME
lines.label: LOSS LEADER

lines.t: Cheap hot dog, expensive cart. Have you fallen for it? Follow for more money tricks.
lines.title: CHEAP DOG, *BIG CART*
